summary: Graphic Packaging Holding Company filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a purported stockholder derivative lawsuit filed on August 14, 2026, against the company and certain current and former officers and directors. The claims, involving federal securities law violations, breach of fiduciary duty, and related allegations, are substantially similar to a previously disclosed June 2026 derivative action. The company intends to defend vigorously. No deal terms are present, and this is a routine litigation disclosure, not a special-situation event.
